_comment: The Agreement's version, and where each of its three documents lives.
Read at build by site/legal-pages.ts (the pages at /terms, /privacy and /refunds) and by ui/src/legal.ts (the version a person accepts).
The two Lambdas that record an acceptance cannot read this file, so each holds AGREEMENT_VERSION as a constant; tests/test_legal_source.py fails if either differs from agreement_version here.
A new version is a new set of files in docs/legal and a new number here. A version already in effect is never edited: acceptances name it.
